method: Decode symbols into a family tree
steps: H x I: H is mother of I
I - J: I is wife of J
J / K: J is father of K
K + L: K is sister of L, so L is child of J and I
I is mother of L and H is mother of I, so H is L’s mother’s mother
check_code:
# H x I: H mother of I; I - J: I wife of J; J / K: J father of K; K + L: K sister of L
mother={'I':'H'}; wife={'I':'J'}; father={'K':'J','L':'J'}
mother_of_L=[w for w,h in wife.items() if h==father['L']][0]
rel='Mother’s mother' if mother.get(mother_of_L)=='H' else None
opts={'A':'Father’s mother','B':'Mother','C':'Mother’s mother','D':'Father’s sister'}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==rel]
assert fit==['C']
